cafe.introduction: A fresh midday table of bright salads, savoury bakes and generous sandwiches.

item.name: Beetroot and feta salad
item.description: Roasted beetroot, baby leaves, pickled pear, walnuts, vegetarian feta and a lemon-herb dressing.

item.name: Sourdough Rye Sandwich
item.description: Grilled chicken, cos lettuce, tomato and mustard mayonnaise on toasted sourdough rye.

item.name: Spinach Pie and Salad
item.description: Golden pastry filled with spinach, ricotta and vegetarian feta, served with a crisp garden salad.

item.name: Feta pancakes with salad
item.description: Savoury egg-and-buttermilk pancakes with vegetarian feta, herbs and a fresh tomato and rocket salad.
